specTitle: Test Case 1: Navigate to All Phones listing via Mobile dropdown
title: AC1: Navigate to Mobile Devices Listing via Mobile dropdown
preconditions:
User has launched https://www.starhub.com/personal.html in a browser.
No prior session / not logged in.
steps:
1. Click the "Mobile" navigation tab to open the dropdown megamenu.
2. In the "Mobile Phones" column click "All Phones".
expected:
Browser navigates to consumer.starhub.com/personal/store/mobile/devices.
"Mobile Devices" heading is visible.
Device listing shows at least one item (count text matches /\d+ items/).

specTitle: Test Case 2: Select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G from the device listing
title: AC2: Select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device from All Phones listing
preconditions: User is on the All Phones listing page: consumer.starhub.com/personal/store/mobile/devices.
steps:
1. Locate the "Galaxy A57 5G" device card.
2. Click the card.
expected:
Browser navigates to a URL containing "galaxy-a57-5g".
"Samsung Galaxy A57 5G" breadcrumb title is visible on the product detail page.

specTitle: Test Case 3: Verify Samsung Galaxy A57 5G default configuration
title: AC3: Verify default colour, storage, and payment options on Galaxy A57 5G PDP
preconditions:
User is on the Galaxy A57 5G product detail page.
No prior selection has been made.
steps:
1. Observe the Colour label above the colour swatches.
2. Observe the Storage label and storage option chips.
3. Observe the Payment option selector.
expected:
Colour label reads "Colour: Awesome Navy" (live default as of April 2026).
Storage label reads "Storage: 256GB" and the 256GB chip is visible.
The "24-month" payment option chip is marked active.

specTitle: Test Case 4: Click Next to initiate the purchase journey next step
title: AC4: Clicking Next on the PDP initiates the next purchase step
preconditions:
User is on the Galaxy A57 5G PDP.
Default configuration is applied (colour, storage, 24-month payment).
User is NOT logged in.
steps: 1. Click the "Next" button in the purchase summary section.
expected:
System initiates the next step — confirmed by the auth gate popup becoming visible.
User remains on the same URL (no full-page redirect).

specTitle: Test Case 5: Verify login and sign-up popup after clicking Next
title: AC5: Login/Sign-up popup is displayed for unauthenticated users clicking Next
preconditions: User is on the Galaxy A57 5G PDP and is NOT logged in.
steps:
1. Click the "Next" button.
2. Observe the popup that appears.
expected:
An overlay modal becomes visible.
Modal message reads: "Please log in or create an account to continue with your purchase".
"Log in with Hub ID" button is visible.
"Don't have an account? Sign up here" button is visible.

specTitle: AC3: Verify default device configuration (Colour, Storage, Payment)
title: Galaxy A57 5G Purchase - AC3: Verify Default Device Configuration
preconditions:
User is on the Samsung Galaxy A57 5G product detail page.
No prior configuration selections have been made.
steps:
1. User is on the Samsung Galaxy A57 5G details page.
2. Observe the Colour label and selected colour swatch.
3. Observe the Storage label and selected storage option.
4. Observe the Payment option selector.
expected:
Following default selections should be applied:
- Colour should be set to Black (or Awesome Navy per live app default)
- Storage should be set to 256 GB
- Payment option should be set to 24-month installment
All selected options should be clearly visible on the page.
Colour label shows "Colour: [colour name]".
Storage label shows "Storage: 256GB" and 256GB chip is visible.
Payment option shows "24-month" as active selection.

specTitle: AC4: Proceed to next step by clicking Next button
title: Galaxy A57 5G Purchase - AC4: Proceed to Next Step
preconditions:
User is on the Galaxy A57 5G PDP.
Default or selected configuration is applied.
User is NOT logged in.
steps:
1. User has reviewed or selected device configuration on the Galaxy A57 5G details page.
2. Click the "Next" button in the purchase section.
expected:
System should initiate the next step in the purchase journey.
The next step is confirmed by the appearance of the login/sign-up authentication gate popup.
User remains on the same URL (no full-page redirect until authentication).

specTitle: AC5: Verify login/sign-up popup for unauthenticated users
title: Galaxy A57 5G Purchase - AC5: Display Login / Sign-Up Popup
preconditions:
User is on the Galaxy A57 5G PDP and is NOT logged in.
User has clicked the "Next" button.
steps:
1. User clicks on "Next" without being logged in.
2. Observe the popup window that appears.
3. Verify the popup message content.
4. Verify the presence of login and sign-up buttons.
expected:
A popup window should be displayed (overlay modal is visible).
The popup should contain the message: "Please log in or create an account to continue with your purchase".
The following options should be visible:
- "Log in with Hub ID" button
- "Don't have an account? Sign up here" button

specTitle: End-to-End: Complete Galaxy A57 5G purchase journey
title: Galaxy A57 5G Purchase - E2E: Complete Purchase Journey
preconditions:
User has launched https://www.starhub.com/personal.html in a browser.
No prior session / not logged in.
steps:
1. Navigate from homepage → Mobile → All Phones.
2. Select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G from listing.
3. Verify default configuration (colour, storage, payment).
4. Click Next button.
5. Verify login/sign-up popup appears with all required elements.
expected:
Complete end-to-end flow executes successfully:
- All Phones listing page loads with devices
- Galaxy A57 5G PDP loads with correct defaults
- Next button triggers authentication gate
- Login popup displays with both login and sign-up options
All 5 acceptance criteria (AC1-AC5) are validated in sequence.
